name: eu-simulation
description: Multi-agent simulation of EU institutional processes: Commissioner personas, College deliberation, inter-service consultation, trilogue, and the full Ordinary Legislative Procedure.

skills.description: Invoke any of 21 Commissioner personas — speaks from treaty mandate, priorities, tensions
Full College of Commissioners meeting — all 21 speak, President calls vote, outcome recorded
ISC round — lead DG circulates, all affected DGs respond, synthesis note produced
Inter-institutional trilogue — EP/Council/Commission negotiate via four-column document
Full OLP from Commission initiative to OJ publication — chains all six phases
EP counter-party agent — committee, rapporteur, group dynamics, amendments, plenary vote
Council counter-party agent — configuration, QMV arithmetic, general approach, Presidency mandate
COREPER session — A/B classification, reservation tracking, QMV check, trilogue mandate recommendation
QMV arithmetic — state and population thresholds, blocking minority, swing state analysis, coalition strategy
AG Opinion simulation — legal question analysis, party arguments, proposed ruling, Art. 252 TFEU independence
Council Presidency chair — compromise texts, non-papers, QMV tracking, general approach, trilogue mandate
Conflict map across all 21 Commissioner portfolios — identifies structurally guaranteed mandate clashes with treaty basis and severity rating
Token-efficient College stress test — runs all 21 Commissioners, returns only SEVERE objections and a College adoptability verdict
Tests subsidiarity justification against 5 member-state configurations — finds where the necessity argument fails and assesses yellow card risk
OLP timeline with blocking dependencies, QMV arithmetic, and trilogue risk points for a proposed regulation or directive
